Happening Soon: 4PM EST Twitter conversation on #metoo and the role of women of color & working class women in this moment w/ @TaranaBurke @aliciagarza and @charlenecac of @BYP_100. Follow us and join the convo!

Happening NOW: We're kicking off our #metoo conversation w/@aliciagarza, #metoo creator @taranaburke & @charlenecac of @BYP_100! While the headlines focus on DC and Hollywood, we’re talking about women of color & low-wage women--what they’re facing & how they’re fighting back.

Welcome @TaranaBurke @CharleneCac & @aliciagarza! Q: Time named #metoo & the silence breakers as person of the year last week (👏🏿@taranaburke!). What does that say about how our culture is beginning to change and recognize the prevalence of sexual assault & harassment?
Twitter friends: What #metoo-related questions do you have for @aliciagarza, @taranaburke and @CharleneCac ? Ask 'em here!

How should we be thinking about #metoo & Black women in particular? Many jobs in cleaning & care work have roots in the legacy of slavery, and racist laws still exclude domestic & farm workers from meaningful labor protections. @aliciagarza @taranaburke @CharleneCac

If a lack of protection & risk of job loss is one of the reasons people don't report abuse and harassment, what does that mean for immigrant and undocumented women, who are facing so many threats right now? #metoo @aliciagarza @taranaburke @charlenecac
Who else do we need to include in the larger #metoo conversation that we haven't been talking about as much? @aliciagarza @taranaburke @charlenecac

#metoo has shown us that sexual harassment and abuse thrive when there's an imbalance in power. How do we change that imbalance, and build power so that all women & all people are treated w/dignity and respect? @aliciagarza @taranaburke @charlenecac

What are some concrete changes we need to make so that women of color & low-income women are protected from sexual harassment and abuse, and protected if they speak out? #metoo @aliciagarza @taranaburke @charlenecac @aijenpoo

Increasing laws and protections can help, but it doesn't solve the problem of sexual harassment. How does our culture need to change so that women and all people can thrive and be safe in their workplaces, homes, and communities? #metoo @aliciagarza @taranaburke @charlenecac
How can we connect #metoo to #blacklivesmatter , #HereToStay, and other movements? @aliciagarza @taranaburke @charlenecac @JessLivMo @UNITEDWEDREAM @WomenBelong
Last question: Where do we take #metoo next? @aliciagarza @taranaburke @charlenecac

To close, thank you @taranaburke @charlenecac & @aliciagarza for your powerful work and for sharing your wisdom in today's #metoo conversation. Everyone should be listening to these three brilliant women.
